title: Great ironing board, but pricey
text:
Great ironing board, but pricey. I've been trying to get the last bit of use out of my 20+ year old ironing board. So I was thrilled to be able to try out the Rowenta Pro Compact Folding Ironing Board. Like other reviewers mentioned, I have issues with the heavy weight of the board as well. I did like being able to open my old board with one hand. It is fussier having to utilize both levers on the newer board. On one occasion, I needed my teen daughter to help me set it up again. I don't hang up my board, I have a space between my washer & wall where I store it. But I can definitely see that it would be too heavy for most hangers. It's very sturdy & I had no issues with ironing clothing or fabric for sewing. I actually prefer muslin covers over reflective (I've never had good luck with the reflective covers) so that is not an issue for me.

Since we're moving in a few months, I also like how compact the board folds up and fits back into the box. So when you need to put it away in storage it shouldn't give you any trouble. Overall, I do like the ironing board, but I don't think I would have bought it myself. I'd likely go with a simpler, more lightweight board that costs less.
